---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["feature", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who has this problem?
Describe the user pain point or need.

## Proposed Solution

Describe your ideal solution. Be specific about:
- User flow / UX
- UI changes
- Data model changes
- API/Firebase changes

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best option?

## Priority

- [ ] **Critical** — Blocks core functionality, security issue
- [ ] **High** — Important for user retention/growth
- [ ] **Medium** — Nice to have, improves experience
- [ ] **Low** — Minor enhancement, polish

## Design References

- Figma/Design files: [link]
- Competitor examples: [links]
- Sketches/wireframes: [attach]

## Technical Considerations

- **Frontend**: New screens, components, state management?
- **Backend**: New Firestore collections, Cloud Functions, Firebase rules?
- **Dependencies**: New packages needed?
- **Performance**: Impact on bundle size, render performance?
- **Testing**: How will this be tested?

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Additional Context

Any other information, constraints, or concerns.
